title: Wartribe Academy 2.0.3
author: 3 Pood Productions
font_credit: MiSans (c) 2020-2021 Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.; DejaVu Sans fallback for two code points
_why_script_override: The game ships no game/tl/<lang>/ translation templates -- only game/tl/None/common.rpym -- so tools/build_tl.py has nothing to compile and tools/install.py has nothing to place. The patch replaces 15 of the game's own .rpy files outright; patch/game/ mirrors the game's game/ directory one for one. There is no data/tl_trans.json, and nothing builds one.
_why_ps1: tools/install.py only knows how to place a translation tree, a shim and fonts. This game needs a script-override installer, so it ships its own next to the patch.
_why_fallback: The game has no {font=} tags anywhere and no hardcoded face outside gui.rpy, so there is nothing to shadow. patch/game/gui.rpy replaces the three gui.*_font defines with a FontGroup: MiSans is the default, and the only two code points MiSans lacks (U+25B8, the animated skip indicator, and U+266A, MUSIC NOTE) go to DejaVuSans. The game ships exactly one typeface of its own, gui/fonts/Nunito-Bold.ttf, and its cmap has zero codepoints in U+3400-U+9FFF -- Latin only, so Chinese drawn in it is tofu.
_coverage_note: 61,417 player-visible literals counted from the English originals, of which 61,294 carry Chinese: 99.79%. The counting rule is not a judgement call, it is data/en_masked/<file>.flags -- one flag per literal, written by the extraction pass that produced the translation, and verified by tools/verify_patch.cjs. The remaining 123 are registered by hand in docs/glossary.json _kept_verbatim, and the check fails if a new one appears that is neither registered nor made only of Ren'Py substitutions and tags. Those 123 are four kinds of thing: Ren'Py's own about screen and key labels, the save-directory name WartribeAcademy, stage directions in *ASTERISKS* form, and the tribal-syllable lines the script itself says nobody understands. Coverage is 61,294/61,417 rather than 100% because those are deliberate. replay_data.rpy is NOT in this figure: it was translated in place before this patch existed and no English baseline of it survives, so its titles cannot be counted against one. tools/verify_patch.cjs says so out loud rather than quietly counting it as zero.
_no_english_source_shipped: data/en_masked/ holds the English scripts with every string literal replaced by a marker recording only its quote style, plus a sidecar of per-literal classification flags. The patch's code skeleton can therefore be proven identical to the original's from a clone of this repository alone, without shipping the game's prose a second time. 3,501,674 bytes of skeleton plus a 66,411-byte flags sidecar carry all of it.
_known_upstream_gap: leona_locked.webp was never shipped with the game, English original included; Leona has leona_gallery and leona_replay_bg but no _locked. Hovering her locked replay card therefore reports a missing image in the English game too. tools/verify_patch.cjs deliberately reads only this repository -- patch/, data/en_masked/, assets/fonts/ and docs/glossary.json -- and never an installed game, so it cannot confirm or deny whether an asset exists and does not pretend to. The gap is recorded here and in README.md instead.
